title: FDS Transformer Provenance Sidecar v1.0.0
description: Where every value the FDS Transformer wrote came from. The transformer writes this file next to its output: one record per document, and in each record one entry per field path it wrote, saying whether the value was read from the source, stood in by a mapping default, generated by a transform, or written by a model. Keys are sorted and nothing in it depends on when the run happened, so the same input gives the same bytes.

records.description: One record per document written, in output order

id.description: The document's id (`exerciseId`, or `id` for other entities), or null if it has none

slug.description: The document's `canonical.slug`, or null if it has none

fields.description: Field path, as the mapping configuration names it, to where its value came from. An entry covers the values beneath its path, except where a deeper path has an entry of its own

from.description: The source path the value was read from

default.description: A configured value standing in for missing data, a mapping `default` or an enrichment `fallback`: not data about the record

transform.description: Generated by a transform with no source value, such as an id or a timestamp

model.description: Written by a model during enrichment

provider.description: The enrichment provider that made the call, such as openrouter or claude-code

model.description: The model that answered, as the provider reports it

promptVersion.description: The first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the prompt's fixed text; it changes when the prompt does

tier.description: The tier that answered, in tiered enrichment

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in the value, from 0 to 1, or null when it reported none
